claims.text: The surrogate is KHRONOS, expanded as Kernel Expansion Hierarchy for Reduced Order, Neural Optimized Surrogates.
claims.evidence_quote: We introduce KHRONOS (Kernel Expansion Hierarchy for Reduced Order, Neural Optimized Surrogates), an AI framework for model based, model free and model inversion tasks.

claims.text: KHRONOS constructs continuously differentiable target fields by hierarchically composing per-dimension kernel expansions, tensorizing them into modes, and superposing them.
claims.evidence_quote: KHRONOS constructs continuously differentiable target fields with a hierarchical composition of per-dimension kernel expansions, which are tensorized into modes and then superposed.

claims.text: The framework is built upon variational principles, interpolation theory, and tensor decomposition.
claims.evidence_quote: Unlike traditional approaches, KHRONOS is built upon variational principles, interpolation theory, and tensor decomposition.

claims.text: The aerodynamic study used AirfRANS as a high-fidelity benchmark and NeuralFoil to generate low-fidelity counterparts, comparing KHRONOS with MLP, GNN, and PINN models.
claims.evidence_quote: Using the AirfRANS dataset as a high-fidelity benchmark and NeuralFoil to generate low-fidelity counterparts, this work compares the performance of KHRONOS with three contemporary model architectures: a multilayer perceptron (MLP), a graph neural network (GNN), and a physics-informed neural network (PINN).

claims.text: The aerodynamic study considered high-fidelity data availability of 0%, 10%, and 30%, and predicted the airfoil surface pressure coefficient distribution.
claims.evidence_quote: We consider varying levels of high-fidelity data availability (0%, 10%, and 30%) and increasingly complex geometry parameterizations. These are used to predict the surface pressure coefficient distribution over the airfoil.

claims.text: In that aerodynamic study, the models eventually achieved comparable predictive accuracy, while KHRONOS used orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters and had much faster training and inference at comparable accuracy in resource-constrained conditions.
claims.evidence_quote: Results indicate that, whilst all models eventually achieve comparable predictive accuracy, KHRONOS excels in resource-constrained conditions. In this domain, KHRONOS consistently requires orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters and delivers much faster training and inference than contemporary dense neural networks at comparable accuracy.

claims.text: On a canonical 2D Poisson equation benchmark, KHRONOS achieved L2-square errors from 5e-4 down to 6e-11 across 16 to 512 degrees of freedom.
claims.evidence_quote: We evaluate KHRONOS on a canonical 2D, Poisson equation benchmark: across 16 to 512 degrees of freedom (DoFs), it obtained L_2-square errors of 5e-4 down to 6e-11.

claims.text: At controlled parameter count, the reported error was greater than 100-fold better than Kolmogorov Arnold Networks.
claims.evidence_quote: This represents a greater than 100-fold gain over Kolmogorov Arnold Networks (which itself reports a 100 times improvement on MLPs/PINNs with 100 times fewer parameters) when controlling for the number of parameters.

claims.text: The paper also reported a 1e6-fold improvement in L2-square error compared to standard linear FEM at comparable degrees of freedom.
claims.evidence_quote: This also represents a 1e6-fold improvement in L_2-square error compared to standard linear FEM at comparable DoFs.

claims.text: Inference complexity was dominated by inner products, enabling sub-millisecond full-field predictions that scale to arbitrary resolution.
claims.evidence_quote: Inference complexity is dominated by inner products, yielding sub-millisecond full-field predictions that scale to an arbitrary resolution.
